title: Bible Foundations Live
description: Ten welcoming questions tracing foundational people, places, and teachings across the Bible.

questions.explanation: Genesis 6–9 tells how Noah built the ark.

questions.question_text: What did God create on the first day?
Who led Israel out of Egypt?
questions.explanation: God called Moses to lead the Exodus.
David trusted God and faced Goliath in 1 Samuel 17.

questions.question_text: Who was swallowed by a great fish?
questions.explanation: Jonah 1 describes Jonah and the great fish.
Matthew 2 and Luke 2 place Jesus’ birth in Bethlehem.

questions.question_text: How many disciples did Jesus appoint?
In Jesus’ parable, who helped the injured traveller?
questions.explanation: The Good Samaritan showed mercy in Luke 10.

questions.question_text: Who wrote many letters in the New Testament?
questions.explanation: Paul’s letters encouraged early Christian communities.

questions.question_text: Which book tells about the early church after Jesus’ ascension?
questions.explanation: Acts records the Spirit’s work through the early church.
